personnelNotes: ABE is published under the City Mayor's Office. Its charter is shorter than the ARTA format the other offices use: it gives who may avail, requirements, client steps, agency action, fees and responsible personnel, but no office or division, classification or transaction type.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Feedback and complaints may be filed with the ABE Division at Gogon, Legazpi City, by mobile on 0927 720 0359, or by email.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: The division's performance pledge, integrated into the city's broader charter, is to serve farmers and fisherfolk by applying engineering principles to improve agriculture, food production, natural resources and environmental management.

services.title: Getting advice on farm structures, machines or irrigation
services.description: Engineering advice for farmers on farm structures, mechanization and irrigation, including a field visit and ocular inspection of your site.
services.whoMayAvail: Registered farmers, and registered farmers' associations and cooperatives

steps.agency: Receives and records the original letter request, refers you to the ABE staff concerned, and conducts a field visit and ocular inspection so you can be advised properly.

verifyNotes: This charter gives one processing time for the whole service and does not break its agency column into numbered actions, so all three actions are recorded as one step.
The charter states its processing time as a maximum. The derived total is that same figure and should be read the same way.
The charter gives no classification or transaction type. Both are inferred here from the service itself and must be checked.

services.title: Borrowing pre and postharvest machinery
services.description: The city's pre and postharvest machinery sent out to your area, with an operator. The service itself is free but you supply the fuel the machine runs on.
services.whoMayAvail: Registered farmers, registered farmers' associations and cooperatives, schools, and government offices

steps.client: Submit the requirements, then accompany the ABE staff to your area.
steps.agency: Checks and records the filled-out machinery dispatch slip form, conducts a site inspection to see whether machinery service is possible in the area, schedules the date of the machinery service operation, and asks you to fill up the client satisfaction feedback form.
steps.feeText: None, but the client is advised to provide the required gasoline or diesel for the actual machinery operation
steps.personResponsible: Engineer II / Engineer I / Farm Machine Operator

notes: There is no fee, but you have to provide the gasoline or diesel the machine uses.
verifyNotes: One processing time for the whole service; all agency actions recorded as one step.
The charter gives no classification or transaction type. Both are inferred here.

services.title: Registering farm or fishery machinery
services.description: Registration of agricultural and fishery machinery and equipment. You get a Certificate of Agricultural and Fisheries Machinery and Equipment Registration approved by the City Mayor, and a registration sticker with a QR code.
services.whoMayAvail: All owners of agricultural and fisheries machinery and equipment, whether an individual farmer or fisherfolk or a registered farmers' association or cooperative

requirements.item: Barangay-issued certificate of location or address of the machinery owner

steps.client: Submit the requirements, then pay the registration fee.
steps.agency: Verifies compliance and processes the application, refers you to the City Treasurer's Office to pay the registration fee, recommends issuance of the Certificate of Agricultural and Fisheries Machinery and Equipment Registration for the City Mayor's approval, and issues the registration sticker with a QR code.
steps.feeText: Registration fee of 300 pesos per machinery or equipment

notes: The 300-peso fee is charged for each machine or piece of equipment.
verifyNotes: One processing time for the whole service; all agency actions recorded as one step.
The charter gives no classification or transaction type. Both are inferred here.

services.title: Requesting a training or seminar on farm machinery
services.description: A meeting, training or seminar on mechanization and facility operations, arranged for a farmers' group, barangay or school. At five minutes this is the quickest thing the division publishes: it is the arranging, not the event.
services.whoMayAvail: Registered farmers and fisherfolk, registered farmers' and fisherfolk's associations and cooperatives, barangays, and schools

steps.agency: Records the letter request, discusses the details of the meeting, training or seminar with you, and schedules its date and venue.

notes: The five minutes covers arranging the session. The training itself is scheduled for a later date.
verifyNotes: One processing time for the whole service; all agency actions recorded as one step.
The charter gives no classification or transaction type. Both are inferred here.
